top_findings: The pricing page shows a wrong price ($1,000 a month) to search and AI crawlers that do not run scripts.
Six product pages tell search engines their address is a page that does not exist.
The cost pages never say what Jira lacks, which edition includes Finances, or what it costs. AI assistants have nothing to quote.
21 new pages went live without a record, so several pages now compete for the same searches.
Changes approved on 9 and 10 November are still waiting to be published.
quick_wins: Correct the fixed price text on the pricing page.
Correct the page addresses in the product page markup (drafts are ready).
Update llms.txt: two dead links out, nine live pages in.
One facts pass: 125 reviews, 'ActivityTimeline' as one word in the header, no 'Server' in the footer.
Publish the approved titles and descriptions.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Pages load securely, with one clear address each

findings.title: Wrong price in the pricing page code
findings.description: Both plan cards read $1,000 a month until a script replaces it with $10 and $15.
findings.recommendation: Make the fixed text match the real starting price.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Product pages are specific and consistent

findings.title: Facts differ between pages
findings.description: 122 and 125 reviews, two spellings of the product name, 'Server' still mentioned, free versus $10 for small teams.
findings.recommendation: One facts pass; two items need a decision.

findings.title: Approved titles and descriptions are not live
findings.description: Most sampled blog posts still do not name ActivityTimeline in their description; one title is cut off mid-word.
findings.recommendation: Publish the approved list, buyer posts and guides first.

findings.title: Product page markup points to missing pages
findings.description: Six pages declare addresses that return 'not found'.

findings.title: Scripts load where they are not needed
findings.description: A form-protection script runs on every page, and a hidden booking widget loads on every pricing visit. Measured in a test environment only; real-visitor data was not available.
findings.recommendation: Load them only where they are used.

findings.title: Cost pages give AI assistants nothing to quote
findings.description: No statement of what Jira lacks, no edition, no price. ActivityTimeline is mentioned in under 8% of cost and budget questions.
findings.recommendation: Add a short 'Jira alone versus with ActivityTimeline' block, the edition and a price pointer.

findings.title: Older image formats on the blog
findings.description: Many blog images are still PNG or JPG.
findings.recommendation: Convert when posts are next edited.

phases.name: Decide first (Ostap)
items: Is the new site structure a go, and when did the 21 pages launch?
Are the Advanced prices and features on the pricing page correct?
Did anyone order link building between April and September 2026?
Small teams: $10 a month, or free for up to 10 users?
Should the markup name Reliex as the company and ActivityTimeline as the product?

phases.name: Fix first
items: Pricing page: correct the fixed price text.
Product pages: correct the addresses in the markup.
llms.txt: remove dead links, add the nine missing pages.
Facts pass: reviews, product name spelling, 'Server' mentions.
Publish the approved titles, descriptions and pricing lines.

phases.name: Fix next
items: Cost tracking page: say where Jira stops, name the edition, point to the price.
Add the software description to home, pricing and product pages.
Clean up the three main guides.
Demo page: add a plain booking link and put the headline first on mobile.
Stop author and category pages from pointing search engines to the blog home.

phases.name: Measure
items: AI citations on product and pricing pages (0 today).
Mention rate on cost and budget questions (7.9% baseline).
Brand clicks and buyer clicks (84 and 21 per 28 days at the last reading).
Reconnect Sitechecker so Search Console data can be read again.

data_sources.description: Home, product, pricing, guide and language pages, robots.txt, sitemap and llms.txt, read directly
Backlinks, referring domains and AI citations
Charter KPIs, fact register, decisions and the last weekly scorecard

data_sources.source: Lab test in a cloud browser
data_sources.description: Page speed and mobile screenshots, without third-party scripts
Search Console, GA4, real-visitor speed data, help centre and Marketplace listing

methodology_note: Scores rank the work to do; they are not a measurement. Clicks and AI mention rates are the 9 November readings.
